name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale is a zero-trust, identity-based connectivity platform built on WireGuard that replaces legacy VPNs with a secure mesh network between devices.
best_for: IT teams managing remote workforces, DevOps engineers managing multi-cloud infrastructure, and developers wanting simplified, secure networking.

tiers.name: Personal (Free)
tiers.notes: Free forever, intended for non-commercial use; up to 6 users, unlimited devices, 50 tagged resources included ($1/month each beyond that).

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Unlimited users; adds SCIM provisioning, MDM config, and device posture checks. As of April 2026 Tailscale bills per assigned seat, not per monthly-active-user -- a seat is billed whether or not that user connects that month.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Adds just-in-time access, advanced SSH, network flow logs, and log streaming. No published annual-billing discount.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales; custom device limits, dedicated support, and pay-by-invoice.

cons: Since April 2026 Tailscale switched from monthly-active-user billing to assigned-seat billing -- a licensed seat is charged even in a month the user never connects.

Device-level admin controls most organizations actually need -- device posture checks, MDM configuration, network flow logs, and SCIM-based provisioning -- are locked behind the Standard tier and above; the free Personal plan has none of this.

The free Personal plan is explicitly restricted to non-commercial use and capped at 6 users, and tagged resources beyond the included 50 cost $1/month each -- businesses cannot legitimately stay on the free tier regardless of team size.
features: Mesh overlay network connecting devices without centralized servers
WireGuard-based encryption for modern cryptographic security
Zero-config networking with setup in minutes
Identity-based access control tying permissions to user identity
Automatic NAT traversal across firewalls and multiple NATs
Support for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and NAS devices

alternatives.name: Cloudflare
alternatives.description: A network and security platform offering CDN, DDoS protection, and zero-trust access tools.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting network performance and security in one platform
